story.text: 창밖 하늘은 맑았지만, 선우는 핸드폰으로 일기예보부터 확인했다.
story.reading: chang-bakk ha-neul-eun malg-at-ji-man, seon-u-neun haen-deu-pon-eu-ro il-gi-ye-bo-bu-teo hwak-in-haet-da.
story.en: The sky outside the window was clear, but Sunwoo checked the weather forecast on his phone first.

story.text: "오늘 일교차가 심하다카네. 아침엔 쌀쌀하고 낮에는 덥고." 그가 화면을 내밀며 미간을 좁혔다.
story.reading: "o-neul il-gyo-cha-ga sim-ha-da-ka-ne. a-chim-en ssal-ssal-ha-go naj-e-neun deop-go." geu-ga hwa-myeon-eul nae-mil-myeo mi-gan-eul jop-hyeot-da.
story.en: "They say today's temperature swing is big. Chilly in the morning, hot in the afternoon." He held out the screen, brow furrowed.

story.text: 바닷바람 때문인지 아침 공기가 유독 습하게 느껴졌다. 옷이 살짝 눅눅해지는 기분이었다.
story.reading: ba-da-ba-ram ttae-mun-in-ji a-chim gong-gi-ga yu-dok seup-ha-ge neu-kkyeo-jyeot-da. os-i sal-jjak nuk-nuk-hae-ji-neun gi-bun-i-eot-da.
story.en: Maybe because of the sea breeze, the morning air felt unusually humid. It felt like my clothes were getting slightly damp.

story.text: "얇은 겉옷 하나 걸치고 나온나. 감기 걸리면 니만 손해다." 그가 잔소리하듯 말했지만 눈빛은 걱정이 가득했다.
story.reading: "yalb-eun geot-os ha-na geol-chi-go na-on-na. gam-gi geol-li-myeon ni-man son-hae-da." geu-ga jan-so-ri-ha-deut mal-haet-ji-man nun-bit-eun geok-jeong-i ga-deuk-haet-da.
story.en: "Throw on a thin jacket before you come out. If you catch a cold, you're the one who loses out." He said it like he was nagging, but his eyes were full of worry.

story.text: 결국 나는 옷장에서 얇은 카디건을 하나 꺼내 걸쳤다. 그제야 선우가 만족한 듯 고개를 끄덕였다.
story.reading: gyeol-guk na-neun ot-jang-e-seo yalb-eun ka-di-geon-eul ha-na kkeo-nae geol-chyeot-da. geu-je-ya seon-u-ga man-jok-han deut go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-yeot-da.
story.en: In the end, I pulled a thin cardigan out of my closet and put it on. Only then did Sunwoo nod, looking satisfied.

story.text: "우산도 챙기라. 오후엔 비 온단다." 그의 말에 나는 서둘러 가방에 작은 우산을 밀어 넣었다.
story.reading: "u-san-do chaeng-gi-ra. o-hu-en bi on-dan-da." geu-ui mal-e na-neun seo-dul-leo ga-bang-e jak-eun u-san-eul mil-eo neoh-eot-da.
story.en: "Bring an umbrella too. It's supposed to rain in the afternoon." At his words, I hurriedly stuffed a small umbrella into my bag.

story.text: "날씨 단어부터 대화 문제까지, 오늘도 끝까지 잘 챙겨봐라."
story.reading: "nal-ssi dan-eo-bu-teo dae-hwa mun-je-kka-ji, o-neul-do kkeut-kka-ji jal chaeng-gyeo-bwa-ra."
story.en: "From the weather words to the conversation questions — pack it all in and get through it today too."

words.example_en: The daily temperature range is large during the change of seasons.
The air is humid during the rainy season.

words.example: 쌀쌀할 때는 겉옷을 챙기는 게 좋다.
words.example_reading: ssal-ssal-hal ttae-neun geot-os-eul chaeng-gi-neun ge jo-ta
words.example_en: It's good to bring outerwear when it's chilly.
I checked this morning's weather forecast.
Be sure to bring an umbrella when you go out.

sentences.en: They say the temperature swing is big today, so let's bring a jacket.
Maybe because it's by the sea, the air is quite humid.

sentences.ko: 얇은 겉옷 하나쯤은 걸치는 게 좋겠다.
sentences.reading: yalb-eun geot-os ha-na-jjeum-eun geol-chi-neun ge jo-ket-da
sentences.en: It'd be good to put on at least one thin jacket.

sentences.ko: 일기예보를 보니 오후에 비가 온다고 한다.
sentences.reading: il-gi-ye-bo-reul bo-ni o-hu-e bi-ga on-da-go han-da
sentences.en: According to the forecast, it's supposed to rain in the afternoon.
I almost forgot to bring an umbrella.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 오늘 일교차 장난 아니라카는데, 니 반팔만 입고 나올 생각이었나?
turns.reading: o-neul il-gyo-cha jang-nan a-ni-ra-ka-neun-de, ni ban-pal-man ib-go na-ol saeng-gak-i-eot-na?
turns.en: They say today's temperature swing is no joke — were you seriously planning to come out in just short sleeves?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어? 그렇게 심해? 일기예보 못 봤는데.
turns.reading: eo? geu-reo-ke sim-hae? il-gi-ye-bo mot bwat-neun-de.
turns.en: Huh? Is it that bad? I didn't see the forecast.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 봐라, 아침 열몇 도에 낮엔 스물몇 도란다. 겉옷 하나는 걸치고 나온나.
turns.reading: bwa-ra, a-chim yeol-myeot do-e naj-en seu-mul-myeot do-ran-da. geot-os ha-na-neun geol-chi-go na-on-na.
turns.en: Look, it's like the low teens in the morning and mid-twenties in the afternoon. Put on a jacket before you come out.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 겉옷을 챙기라고 한 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sunwoo tell the passenger to bring a jacket?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 아침과 낮의 기온차, 즉 일교차가 크다며 겉옷을 챙기라고 말했습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: It's supposed to rain in the afternoon. Did you bring an umbrella?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Ah right, I forgot. I guess I have to go back in.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 됐다, 내한테 접이식 우산 하나 더 있다. 이거 써라.
turns.reading: dwaet-da, nae-han-te jeob-i-sik u-san ha-na deo it-da. i-geo sseo-ra.
turns.en: It's fine, I've got an extra folding umbrella. Use this one.

dialogues.question: 승객이 우산을 챙기지 못한 것을 알았을 때 선우는 어떻게 했나요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo do when he found out the passenger forgot her umbrella?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 자신이 가진 여분의 접이식 우산을 승객에게 빌려주었습니다.
